arxiv-2111-08550.title: On Effective Scheduling of Model-based Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2111-08550.creator: Hang Lai, Jian Shen, Weinan Zhang, Yimin Huang, Xing Zhang, Ruiming Tang, Yong Yu, Zhenguo Li
arxiv-2111-08550.description: Abstract Model-based reinforcement learning has attracted wide attention due to its superior sample efficiency. Despite its impressive success so far, it is still unclear how to appropriately schedule the important hyperparameters to achieve adequate performance, such as the real data ratio for policy optimization in Dyna-style model-based algorithms.

arxiv-2203-03005.title: Self-Supervised Face Image Restoration with a One-Shot Reference
arxiv-2203-03005.creator: Yanhui Guo, Fangzhou Luo, Shaoyuan Xu
arxiv-2203-03005.description: Abstract For image restoration, methods leveraging priors from generative models have been proposed and demonstrated a promising capacity to robustly restore photorealistic and high-quality results. However, these methods are susceptible to semantic ambiguity, particularly with images that have obviously correct semantics such as facial images. In this paper, we propose a semantic-aware latent space exploration method for image restoration (SAIR).

arxiv-2405-03917.title: KV Cache is 1 Bit Per Channel: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Coupled Quantization
arxiv-2405-03917.creator: Tianyi Zhang, Jonah Yi, Zhaozhuo Xu, Anshumali Shrivastava
arxiv-2405-03917.description: Abstract Efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires batching multiple requests together to improve throughput. As the batch size, context length, or model size increases, the size of the key and value (KV) cache can quickly become the main contributor to GPU memory usage and the bottleneck of inference latency.

arxiv-2409-12380.title: Bundle Fragments into a Whole: Mining More Complete Clusters via Submodular Selection of Interesting webpages for Web Topic Detection Journal: X

arxiv-2409-12380.description: Abstract Organizing interesting webpages into hot topics is one of key steps to understand the trends of multimodal web data. In the past few decades there has been a significant elucidation of the immune and neural pathways which underly the sensation of itch. An interesting divergence in the itch pathway relates to the type of stimulation used to evoke an itchy sensation.

pmc-12621479.title: Prevention and control of dengue and Aedes mosquitoes in South and Southeast Asia: Interventions, challenges, and future recommendations
pmc-12621479.creator: Iskandar Arfan, Lilis Sulistyorini, Muji Sulistyowati, Ayu Rizky, Saliza Mohd Elias
pmc-12621479.description: Dengue fever, caused by a virus transmitted through Aedes mosquitoes, has become a major health issue in South and Southeast Asia. This review explores various preventive and control interventions for dengue implemented in South and Southeast Asia, the challenges faced, and recommendations to enhance the sustainability and effectiveness of these control efforts.

pmc-12973473.title: Real world incidence, predictors and outcomes of endocrine immune-related adverse events following immune checkpoint inhibitors
pmc-12973473.creator: Shuwen Tan, Yuhan Wang, Yunjia Cai, Hongzhou Guo, Ying Gao
pmc-12973473.description: Endocrine dysfunction is one of the most common immune-related adverse events (irAEs) reported in immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) clinical trials. The aim of this research was to thoroughly assess the clinical features of endocrine irAEs, investigate the risk and predictive variables, and provide guidance for clinical therapy.

pmc-13242587.title: Barriers to the Implementation of Iran’s Clean Air Act: A Policy-Oriented Scoping Review
pmc-13242587.creator: Hossein Bouzarjomehri, Mohammad Hassan Ehrampoush, Ali Asghar Ebrahimi, Zahra Soltanianzadeh, Mohsen Khosravi, Yasaman Herandi, Seyed Masood Mousavi, Mohammad Ranjbar
pmc-13242587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Air pollution remains a serious environmental and public-health issue in Iran. Despite the Clean Air Act (CAA), enforcement is limited and compliance is weak. This 2025 scoping review outlines major barriers to CAA enforcement and proposes evidence-based policy actions. Multiple databases including Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and Google Scholar were searched and Policy documents, institutional reports, and legal texts were identified through Google and official organizational websites. Finally, a thematic analysis was conducted on the data using a four-dimensional conceptual framework.

uslaw-usc-t40-s3102.title: 40 U.S.C. § 3102 — Naming or designating buildings
uslaw-usc-t40-s3102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s3102.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Part A (General); Chapter 31 (General); Subchapter I (Oversight And Regulation Of Public Buildings). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Administrator of General Services may name or otherwise designate any building under the custody and control of the General Services Administration, regardless of whether it was previously named by statute.
